raw_comment: I notice that most of the US is covered with areas of drought. The graph shows the central states yet not really Colorado experiencing drought. Which I found pretty interesting because it is a central state. Montana and Ohio have an extremely high drought number, being in the center of the US means less access to water income and water cycles to produce rain surplus. This can negatively affect humans, animals and breathing.
